meta.title: MARAGON® register of personal social-media accounts for Personalitete Mediatike (excluding Grida DUMA)
excluded: Grida DUMA (vip_m2) — excluded in full by owner instruction of 27 Nov 2026; no accounts researched or recorded for her.
verification_rules: A matching name alone is not proof.

VERIFIED only with at least one of: (1) linked from an official broadcaster/employer page or the person's official website; (2) linked from the MARAGON profile's own source list; (3) platform verification badge plus consistent identity (bio naming their programme/channel); (4) cited by a credible outlet as their account.
Everything else that looks plausible is UNCERTAIN, for Dr Alban Gj. THIKA's review, not to be shown publicly.
Programme or broadcaster accounts are not treated as personal accounts.
No private contact information, emails or phone numbers were collected.
Accounts were looked up only; none were followed, messaged or otherwise interacted with.
X / Twitter Blue (verified_type=blue) was not treated as sufficient on its own, because it is a paid badge.

personalities.name: Ardit GJEBREA
personalities.notes: He has said his only genuine Facebook presence is the verified page, but no outlet published the Facebook URL. The former official site arditgjebrea.info has been hijacked by unrelated content and was not used.

accounts.verification_basis: Cited by ArkivaNews (10 Dec 2020) as the URL he himself identified as his only Instagram, in a warning about impostor accounts. The Instagram profile is platform-verified and the bio names «Kënga Magjike» and «E Diela Shqiptare». Telegrafi later quoted the same warning.

Looked up on X on 27 Nov 2026: display name arditgjebrea, bio “Songwriter & Singer, Tv Host, Tv Producer”, about 1,076 followers, not platform-verified. Consistent occupation language, but a matching name and generic bio is not enough without a badge naming the programme or a news citation of this handle.

Politiko.al reported in 2018 that he had joined Twitter, but did not publish this handle. Strong identity fit, held for review because the standing rule needs a badge or a cited handle.
Cited by TPZ.al (26 Jun 2019) with an Instagram embed: “A post shared by Armina Mevlani (@armina_mevlani)”.
